subject: Proposed kickoff windows & final attendee ask
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ava Barnes <ava.barnes@clearedhealth.com>, Samir Kapoor <samir.kapoor@clearedhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 08 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed kickoff windows & preliminary agenda

Hi Ava / Samir —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood. We're excited to get the intake and implementation kicked off. To make scheduling quick, here are three windows that work for our core delivery team (PT):

- Tue May 11 — 9:00–10:00 AM PT (recommended, shorter intro + tech deep-dive)
- Thu May 13 — 10:00–11:30 AM PT (preferred for full stakeholder presence)
- Fri May 14 — 1:00–2:00 PM PT (backup)

Please let us know which of these works for your team and who will attend from Cleared Health (roles are helpful: PM, Eng, Security). Also confirm whether the session should be recorded and whether you prefer Zoom or your org's preferred bridge.

Preliminary agenda (30–90 min options):
- 0–10m: introductions + success criteria
- 10–30m: product overview + high-level architecture
- 30–60m: implementation plan, milestone calendar, and responsibilities
- 60–80m: access & security checklist (SOC 2 artifacts, network)
- 80–90m: Q&A & immediate next steps (MVP scope, POC data)

I've attached a short pre-kickoff checklist that helps speed through access items if you can share it with your eng/security team before the call.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: pre-kickoff-checklist.pdf (1 page)
From: Ava Barnes <ava.barnes@clearedhealth.com>

Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed kickoff windows & preliminary agenda

Thanks Marissa —

Thu May 13 10:00–11:30 AM PT works best for the broader group. Attendees from our side:
- Ava Barnes (Product Lead)
- Samir Kapoor (Engineering Manager)
- Priya Nair (Security, eng-ops@clearedhealth.com)
- Lucas Myers (SRE) — may join for the network/access portion

Please record; Zoom is fine. Also can you include a public dial-in number and plan to share the recording and slides. We do have a brief procurement kickoff on Friday but want the technical onboarding this week if possible.

On the agenda: please add a 10 minute block to cover our data retention requirements and HIPAA considerations — Samir will lead that section.

Best,
Ava
